headline: Airwallex upgrades its business accounts so AI agents can move money and manage FX
body: Airwallex has upgraded its Agentic Business Accounts to let AI agents, including its own assistant Kai, carry out corporate finance tasks such as moving money, managing foreign exchange exposure and rebalancing liquidity, within rules, permissions and approval controls businesses set themselves. Airwallex holds 89 licenses and permits globally, spent the past decade building that infrastructure, and CEO Jack Zhang wrote, "The unit of work shifts from transaction to outcome."
note: Airwallex is betting that corporate treasury work shifts from single payment instructions to agents pursuing broader cash and FX goals continuously, a model other banking-as-a-service providers and transaction banks will likely have to match once corporate clients expect it.

evidence.text: Airwallex has upgraded its Agentic Business Accounts to support AI agents in carrying out corporate finance tasks within rules, permissions and approval controls set by businesses.
The accounts can connect with Airwallex’s AI assistant, Kai, or another preferred AI agent.
These agents can support tasks such as moving money, managing foreign exchange exposure, rebalancing liquidity and putting idle cash to work.
Jack Zhang, Co-founder and CEO of Airwallex, wrote in a recent blog post that the shift towards agentic banking could change how companies manage money across their operations.
“The unit of work shifts from transaction to outcome,” Zhang wrote.
Airwallex currently holds 89 licenses and permits globally and has spent the past decade building its international financial infrastructure.
